description: CM Devendra Fadnavis unveils Maharashtra’s AI-based agriculture policy with Rs 500 crore outlay, promoting Maha-Vistar AI and smart farming.
body_lead: Mumbai, Feb 23: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis announced that the state has become the first in India to host a dedicated Artificial Intelligence conference focused on agriculture, positioning itself as a national leader in AI-driven farming transformation.
